title.narrative: Code 1_2025 “Strengthening the Capacity of the ACT Alliance in Sierra Leone to Promote Gender Justice”

description.narrative: The proposed intervention is closely aligned with the core priorities and strategic vision of the ACT Alliance global network, which emphasizes gender justice, humanitarian effectiveness, and building resilient communities worldwide. Firstly, the project supports the ACT Alliance’s global commitment to advancing gender justice as a cross-cutting theme. By strengthening the capacity of the Sierra Leone Forum to promote gender-transformative programming, the intervention contributes to ACT’s broader agenda of challenging systemic inequalities and promoting the rights and dignity of women, girls, and marginalized groups across all member contexts. Secondly, the initiative addresses the global priority of enhancing coordination and collaboration among ACT members to improve the quality, coherence, and impact of humanitarian and development responses. The lack of a unified strategic framework and weak internal coordination at the country level hinders collective action. This project’s focus on developing a strategic plan and improving coordination mechanisms directly responds to this gap, reflecting ACT’s emphasis on strong national forums as a foundation for collective impact. Furthermore, the intervention aligns with ACT Alliance’s focus on resilience-building — strengthening the ability of communities and organizations to prepare for, respond to, and recover from crises. By equipping member organizations with skills and strategies to support vulnerable populations sustainably, the project contributes to ACT’s global goal of fostering sustainable development and disaster risk reduction. Lastly, this intervention promotes knowledge sharing, learning, and advocacy, key pillars of ACT Alliance’s global operations. Strengthening internal learning systems and improving advocacy positioning within Sierra Leone enhances the Alliance’s global network effectiveness and influence. Overall, this project exemplifies the ACT Alliance’s commitment to locally led, collaborative, and gender-responsive approaches, thereby reinforcing and advancing the global agenda through targeted national-level action.
